title: Task Manager icons eat the first click made after dismissing their context menu by clicking on something other than plasmashell
line: Right-clicking a task opens its menu every time, even right after its menu was closed by clicking in another window.
explanation: The task's right-click TapHandler opens the context menu on press, and the menu then takes the pointer grab, so the release goes to the menu. When the menu is closed by clicking another window, plasmashell never sees that release and the handler stays 'pressed'; the next right-press therefore causes no pressedChanged and no menu, and only its release resets the handler, so menus opened on every other right-click. The handler now also reacts to pointChanged: a right-button press arriving while it still thinks it is pressed (and no menu is open or pending) opens the menu too.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: reopen context menu after dismissing it elsewhere

The context menu opens on press and takes the pointer grab, so closing
it by clicking another window leaves the right-click handler pressed and
the next press was ignored; now that press opens the menu as well.

BUG: 511826

patches.diff:
From 24997068137182ce942f0ed1fda9d4760e535a10 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:35:56 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: reopen context menu after dismissing it
 elsewhere

The context menu opens on press and takes the pointer grab, so closing
it by clicking another window leaves the right-click handler pressed and
the next press was ignored; now that press opens the menu as well.

BUG: 511826
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml | 6 ++++++
 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
index 90530078c5..f253dd9cf2 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
@@ -410,6 +410,12 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
         acceptedButtons: Qt.RightButton
         acceptedDevices: PointerDevice.Mouse | PointerDevice.TouchPad | PointerDevice.Stylus
         onPressedChanged: if (pressed) contextMenuTimer.start()
+        // When the menu is closed by clicking another window, the handler never
+        // sees the release and stays pressed, so treat the next press as a new one.
+        onPointChanged: if (pressed && (point.pressedButtons & Qt.RightButton) && !contextMenuTimer.running
+                                && task.contextMenu?.status !== PlasmaExtras.Menu.Open) {
+            contextMenuTimer.start();
+        }
     }
 
     Timer {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: four cycles of right-click on the Konsole task, then click in Dolphin; the menu opens only on cycles 2 and 4
With the fix: the same four cycles open the menu every time

review.text: The cause is real: the menu takes the pointer grab on press, so the TapHandler never sees the release and stays pressed. Qt should cancel that point, and Qt is upstream, so a small QML workaround in Task.qml is fair. The guards (right button held, timer not running, menu not open) keep it from firing twice. The media and regression checks cover the cycle, hover, Escape and left-click cases.
